key_extractions.title: Unconventional superconductivity in magic-angle graphene superlattices
key_extractions.relevance: Introduces MATBG superconductivity at low density, T_c=1.7K, dome phase diagram, small Fermi surface.

key_extractions.title: Topology-Bounded Superfluid Weight in Twisted Bilayer Graphene
key_extractions.relevance: Superfluid weight D_s = integral Fubini-Study metric, lower bounded by C_{2z}T Wilson loop winding. Topology enhances D_s despite flat bands.
methods: uniform s-wave pairing on flat bands

key_extractions.title: Evidence for unconventional superconductivity in twisted bilayer graphene
key_extractions.relevance: STM: V-shaped gap, anisotropic nodal pairing, pseudogap precursor, 2Delta/kT_c ~25 tunneling vs ~6 Andreev, absent in aligned hBN.

key_extractions.title: Mapping the twist-angle disorder and Landau levels in magic-angle graphene
key_extractions.relevance: Twist angle disorder affects correlated states, gradients induce in-plane E fields.

updates_to_contract: Role of C2T symmetry and disorder
